zh: 台湾阳明交通大学（National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University，简称阳明交大）是中国台湾省顶尖研究型大学，2021年由原台湾交通大学与阳明大学合并而成，以"双城多校区"布局串联台北、新竹两市，兼具理工医优势与优美校园环境。在2026年QS世界大学排名中位列全球第199位，就业竞争力与学术认可度稳居台湾前列。学校为世界及台湾培育高科技人才之摇篮，尤其在电机、资讯及光電等领域已占世界頂尖領導之地位。
en: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU) is a top research university in Taiwan, China, formed by the merger of National Chiao Tung University and National Yang Ming University in 2021. With a "twin-city, multi-campus" layout connecting Taipei and Hsinchu cities, it combines strengths in engineering, science, and medicine with beautiful campus environments. Ranked 199th in the QS World University Rankings 2026, it maintains leading positions in employment competitiveness and academic recognition in Taiwan. The university serves as a cradle for cultivating high-tech talents for Taiwan and the world, particularly in electrical engineering, information technology, and optoelectronics, where it holds world-leading positions.
